consumptionData.methodology: Honda publishes a combined WMTC fuel-consumption value. Category rates are estimated around that value: urban is slightly higher for stop-start scooter use, interurban is lower for steady moderate speeds, motorway is higher for sustained high speed, and unknown uses the published combined value.

sources.title: Forza 350 specifications and price
sources.notes: Used for 2025 model, 330 cc displacement, and 3.4 L/100 km WMTC combined fuel consumption.
